claims.statement: Ben and I settled on one dinner occasion this week.

question: How many dinner plans did Ben and I settle on this week?

review.coverage_reason: Claim establishes the single rescheduled dinner count required by intent.

reviews.reason: Dialogue shows Thursday dinner was moved to Saturday, leaving one occasion, not two.

question_review.reason: Prompt asks for count without giving answer (one) and presupposes only Ben, dinner, this week which are supported by proposal and reschedule. No cross-session reference needed. Answering requires considering both original Thursday proposal and Saturday reschedule to conclude one current occasion, so it elicits the expected fact.

test_intent: One dinner. Only the number of dinner occasions is being judged; rescheduling the original plan did not add a second dinner.
